full_name: Nagwan Soliman | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Policy & Practice Robert G. James Scholar Fellow Georgetown University
bio: Nagwan Soliman is an affiliate scholar at Georgetown Institute for Women, Peace and Security. She specializes in women and peace process, political polarization between political movements, and sectarian tensions between Muslims and Christians in the Arab region.
